messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Leisure, tourism and sport, Social behaviour and attitudes, Media, TRANSPORT AND TRAVEL, Consumption and consumer behaviour, Economic systems and development, and Economic conditions and indicators in Finland during the 1960s, matching this research need: Survey data on European household consumption, durable goods, car ownership, drinking habits, media use, travel, advertising attitudes, social tolerance, and public opinions on the EEC, with detailed demographic and housing variables.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
